justifications.type_expressiveness: RomanError is a well-designed enum with distinct variants carrying relevant data (the offending value or character), and no stringly-typed or boolean-tagged data is used.
justifications.error_handling: Typed error enum with meaningfully distinct variants (OutOfRange, Empty, InvalidCharacter, NotCanonical), no panics or unwraps in library code, and overflow is avoided via u64 accumulation.
justifications.api_ergonomics: Narrow public surface with complete derives (Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq), Display impl, doc comments on every public item, and naming consistent with std conventions.
justifications.idiomaticity: Uses iterator-based char validation, matches! in tests, slice patterns, Option chaining via get/copied/map, and a clean greedy table-driven encoder with no unnecessary clones.
